taylor_sales: Quick triage  Northbridge wants a 4-day POC with their internal model 'zenith-sparrow-20b' for generation + embeddings. They insist on VPC-only hosting (no model copy on multi-tenant hosts). Can SE/infra/security confirm feasibility and blockers?
harpreet_se: Do we have artifacts and tokenizer? What format?
taylor_sales: Provided an S3 staging link (private) with GGUF + tokenizer.json + small eval set. They flag that redistribution is not allowed.
harpreet_se: Good. Key checks: tokenizer (bpe vs spm), attention type (rotary/ALiBi), and whether the gguf includes tokenizer merges. For embeddings compatibility, confirm CLS token behavior and pooling scheme. If tokenizer missing merges we can generate using their vocab but need confirmation.
lucas_infra: VPC-only is doable via Private deployment. We can set up a customer VPC connector and mount their staging bucket; runtime will stream artifacts and we won't keep copies on multi-tenant hosts. Lead time ~4 business days for network + IAM config. For a short POC we can spin an isolated Private runtime in their VPC.
harpreet_se: Perf notes: zenith-sparrow-20b at 4-bit + 8k ctx is fine on a single 80GB node for low concurrency. They didn't specify ctx; ask them. If they want >16k contexts or concurrent embeddings+gen, recommend Dedicated capacity in their VPC or a private pool.
irene_security: Security blockers: license prohibits redistribution  Hosted multi-tenant is blocked. Private/VPC path fine but requires signed DPA and license attestation. We also need an SBOM/SCA scan of their artifact. If they plan to pass PII during the POC we need a data handling addendum.
taylor_sales: Pricing question: they asked for rough POC pricing for Private/VPC vs Dedicated reserved. Also any one-time variant validation fee?
lucas_infra: Ballpark: Private/VPC short POC (single isolated node, networking + ops) ~= $3k/day. Dedicated reserved (2 nodes in their VPC) for a week ~= $16k-20k depending on egress/KMS. Variant validation / adapter work ~= $1,000 one-time. Exact numbers from finance.
harpreet_se: SE plan: 1) tokenizer adapter check, 2) build 4-bit and 8-bit variants in their VPC (no external copying), 3) run their eval set (200 queries) and compare to baseline, 4) perf sweep at concurrency 1/3 and ctx slices (512/4k/8k). ETA ~3 business days after VPC staging is ready.
irene_security: Quick list for sales email: 1) VPC-only path requires network setup (~4 business days) and signed DPA + license attestation, 2) lack of redistribution means no Hosted option, 3) if they push >8k contexts or high concurrency we may need Dedicated nodes in-VPC.
taylor_sales: Great. Can SE start work as soon as we get staging access? I'll request exact ctx and confirm whether embeddings pooling uses CLS or mean pooling. Also ask them to confirm they accept SCA scan.
harpreet_se: I'll watch the staging bucket and start builds once access confirmed. We'll run the 4-bit variant first.
build-bot: Created ticket SE-9999 "Northbridge zenith-sparrow 20b VPC POC" assigned to harpreet_se, due 2025-01-15. :white_check_mark:
